primary.title: Automotive Axles share price jumps 15%: Why the small-cap stock rallied in trade today. Do you own? Check stock trend
primary.summary: Automotive Axles shares surged nearly 15% after the company reported strong Q2 FY27 results. Net profit rose 66.7% to ₹60 crore, revenue grew 43.5% to ₹663 crore, and EBITDA increased 73.7%, lifting the margin to 12.6%. Raman K was appointed CFO.
